metod-1: a shallow round glass tray holding about ten glass marbles of the same size; three of them glow warm orange, the rest are clear blue glass.
metod-2: two dice side by side, one made of clear blue glass and one realistic white die with dark pips, standing on a thin frosted glass tile with a 6 by 6 grid; one cell of the grid glows warm orange.
metod-3: three coins in a row: two lying flat made of clear blue glass and one realistic gold coin flipping in the air above them, with a faint glowing dotted arc showing its flip.
metod-4: a small round glass table with six glass chairs around it; one chair glows warm orange, the chair next to it glows soft blue, the others are clear glass.
metod-5: a thick glass disk split into two pieces slightly pulled apart: a small slice glowing warm orange and the large remaining part of clear blue glass.
primer-1a: a large magnifying glass, a deerstalker cap made of blue glass, a curved tobacco pipe and a fan of sealed envelopes on a small glass table; three envelopes glow warm orange.
primer-1b: an old-fashioned small travelling carriage (britzka) made of blue glass next to a long unrolled paper scroll list and a quill pen; one line of the scroll glows warm orange.
primer-2a: a single realistic white die with dark pips resting on a small square of green card-table cloth, next to a small old-fashioned barrel organ (hurdy-gurdy) made of blue glass.
primer-2: two realistic white dice with dark pips tumbling on a green card-table cloth inside a blue glass box, a deck of playing cards fanned beside them, a small glass goblet.
primer-3a: two identical small blue glass toy rattles lying crossed, and one realistic gold coin spinning in the air above them.
primer-3b: an old wooden chair made of blue glass with a realistic white captain's cap with a dark visor lying on its seat, and a gold coin spinning in the air above.
primer-4a: a round blue glass table set for a tea party with a glass teapot, several glass teacups and a tall realistic top hat lying on the table; around it nine small glass chairs, two neighbouring chairs glow warm orange.
primer-4b: two crossed fencing sabres made of blue glass over a realistic dark red hussar shako with gold braid, and a small glass bowl with folded paper lots.
primer-5a: a tiny blue glass flea wearing microscopic golden horseshoes standing on a glass plate under an old brass microscope.
primer-5b: a sealed envelope with a red wax seal and a quill pen in a glass inkwell, a small stack of letters made of blue glass.
